name: Chelsea Immutable Identity Migration v2.0 — HARDENED STAGED

parameters.content:
## Immutable identity migration
Переводит legacy username namespace в actor namespace. Вход должен быть заморожен cutover-процедурой. Создаёт Qdrant alias, переносит tenant files, мигрирует legacy Data Tables, обновляет PostgreSQL principal/record store и возвращает проверенный receipt.

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const req=$('Code | Validate Immutable Migration | IdentityMigration').first().json;const status=Number($json.statusCode||$json.status||0);const body=$json.body??$json;if(status&&status>=400)throw new Error(`identity_migration_qdrant_alias_list_failed:${status}`);const aliases=body?.result?.aliases||body?.aliases||[];if(!Array.isArray(aliases))throw new Error('identity_migration_qdrant_alias_list_invalid');const found=aliases.filter(a=>String(a.alias_name||a.aliasName||'')===req.qdrantCollection);if(found.length>1)throw new Error('identity_migration_qdrant_alias_duplicate');if(found.length===1){const target=String(found[0].collection_name||found[0].collectionName||'');if(target!==req.legacyQdrantCollection)throw new Error('identity_migration_qdrant_alias_owned_by_other_collection');return [{json:{...req,qdrantAliasCreateRequired:false,qdrantAliasExistingTarget:target}}];}return [{json:{...req,qdrantAliasCreateRequired:true,qdrantAliasBody:{actions:[{create_alias:{collection_name:req.legacyQdrantCollection,alias_name:req.qdrantCollection}}]}}}];

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const req=$('Code | Validate Immutable Migration | IdentityMigration').first().json;const body=$json.body??$json;const aliases=body?.result?.aliases||body?.aliases||[];if(!Array.isArray(aliases))throw new Error('identity_migration_qdrant_alias_readback_invalid');const found=aliases.filter(a=>String(a.alias_name||a.aliasName||'')===req.qdrantCollection);if(found.length!==1||String(found[0].collection_name||found[0].collectionName||'')!==req.legacyQdrantCollection)throw new Error('identity_migration_qdrant_alias_readback_mismatch');return [{json:{...req,qdrantAliasVerified:true,qdrantAliasTarget:req.legacyQdrantCollection}}];

nodes.name: Code | Verify Immutable Qdrant Alias | IdentityMigration

parameters.command: =set -euo pipefail; ROOT=${CHELSEA_USER_FILES_ROOT:-/files/chelsea}; OLD='{{ $json.legacyTenantId }}'; NEW='{{ $json.tenantId }}'; case "$OLD:$NEW" in tenant_[a-z0-9_]*:tenant_actor_[a-f0-9]*) ;; *) echo '{"success":false,"error":"invalid_identity_paths"}'; exit 2;; esac; O="$ROOT/$OLD"; N="$ROOT/$NEW"; for P in "$O" "$N"; do [ ! -L "$P" ] || { echo '{"success":false,"error":"symlink_blocked"}'; exit 3; }; done; mkdir -p "$ROOT"; if [ -d "$O" ] && [ ! -e "$N" ]; then mv "$O" "$N"; elif [ -d "$O" ] && [ -d "$N" ]; then cp -a "$O"/. "$N"/; rm -rf --one-file-system "$O"; elif [ ! -e "$N" ]; then mkdir -p "$N"; fi; [ -d "$N" ] && [ ! -e "$O" ] || { echo '{"success":false,"error":"file_migration_readback_failed"}'; exit 4; }; printf '{"success":true,"newTenantPath":"%s","legacyAbsent":true}\n' "$N"

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const source=$('Code | Verify Immutable Files Namespace | IdentityMigration').first().json;const receipts=$input.all().map(i=>i.json||{});if(receipts.some(r=>r.success!==true))throw new Error('identity_migration_data_table_receipt_failed');const names=new Set(receipts.map(r=>r.tableName));const expected=['BD ProfileAnswers','Obsidian RAG Chat Memory','Obsidian RAG User Profile Memory','Obsidian RAG Interaction Log','Obsidian RAG Diagnostics Log','Chelsea Soul'];for(const n of expected)if(!names.has(n))throw new Error(`identity_migration_missing_table_receipt:${n}`);return [{json:{...source,dataTableMigrationVerified:true,dataTableReceipts:receipts}}];

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const source=$('Code | Verify Data Table Migration Receipts | IdentityMigration').first().json;const body=$json.body??$json;const receipt=Array.isArray(body)?body[0]:body;if(receipt?.success!==true||receipt?.verified!==true||receipt?.migrationStatus!=='completed')throw new Error('identity_migration_postgres_receipt_failed');const ready=String(receipt.registrationState||source.registrationState||'')==='ready';return [{json:{...source,identityStorageMigrationRequired:false,identityMigrationVerified:true,identityClaimsVerified:true,identityAuthorityVerified:true,identityUsable:ready,identityMigrationReceipt:{contractVersion:'chelsea_identity_migration_receipt_v2',qdrantAliasVerified:true,filesMigrationVerified:true,dataTableMigrationVerified:true,postgresVerified:true,details:receipt,completedAtIso:new Date().toISOString()},registrationState:ready?'ready':String(receipt.registrationState||source.registrationState||'processing'),registrationStage:ready?'ready':String(receipt.registrationStage||'immutable_storage_migrated')}}];
